_readme: Scripts live in .claude/hooks/ and read their payload as JSON on stdin (needs jq or node).
Only exit 2 blocks; the scripts translate failures accordingly.
Run .claude/hooks/test-hooks.sh after editing any hook; it asserts the guard blocks what it claims to.
The guard is a speed bump against momentum, not a security boundary, and has no override token:
when it blocks something the owner wants, the owner runs it with '! <command>' or disables the hook.
Personal permission allowlists stay in settings.local.json (not committed).
